notes: Unlike vv. 7–13, no article morpheme opens the phrase, so the first *the* joins the substantival numeral under rule 15's substantival case, together with the italic *captain* under rule 31.
In the following phrase an article morpheme does stand on `הַחֹדֶשׁ`, so it takes the written *the* before a supplied reading does (rules 15 and 29).
